title.narrative: Strengthening Collective Gender Responsive and inclusive Accountability to Affected People in OPT

description.narrative: This is a special Protection project under the AAP envelope in UFE round 2 2024. The project's objective is to strengthen the collective gender-responsive and inclusive accountability to the affected people (AAP) in the OPT through the establishment of a Community Feedback Mechanism (CFM) in the West Bank and Gaza Strip . The CFM is a complete system that encompasses communication channels that enable the affected population to communicate on needs, complaints, provide feedback and request assistance. It also encompasses the procurement and adaptation of a Customer Relations Mechanism (CRM) to receive, host, and manage inputs from different sources.
